claims.claim: pike entered artificial structure only below 600 stems m⁻²
claims.note: Full text not read (the paper already flags 'abstract'). The abstract: laboratory video trials with artificial stems at 200, 400 and 600 stems m⁻²; pike were 'only selecting structured habitats when stem densities were less than 600 stems m−2'. So 'below 600' means at the two lower densities tested (200 and 400), and the abstract speaks of habitat SELECTION (preference), not of whether pike could enter the 600-stem structure; 'entered … only below 600' overstates it. Suggested: 'pike selected structured habitat at 200 and 400 but not 600 artificial stems m⁻² (laboratory; abstract)'.
